title: Capability Compilation Result v1
description: Host-controlled compilation evidence recording the translation of approved evaluation results into CapabilityPayloadV1 candidates. Confers zero execution permission or direct authority.

schema_version.description: Semantic type identity. Distinct from evaluation, proposal, and capability schemas.

evaluation_reference.description: Cryptographic reference binding this compilation evidence to the specific EFFECT_EVALUATION_RESULT-v1 instance.

proposal_reference.description: Cryptographic reference binding this compilation evidence to the exact source EFFECT_PROPOSAL-v1 instance.

compilation_status.description: Terminal status of the host-controlled compilation attempt.

compilation_timestamp.description: Deterministic ISO-8601 timestamp representing when compilation occurred.

candidate_payload_reference.description: Optional reference to the generated CapabilityPayloadV1 candidate. Enforced via conditional branching.

failure_reason_class.description: Categorized classification of compilation failure. Enforced via conditional branching.

compiler_identity.description: Identifier of the host compilation routine or subsystem responsible for translation.
